Key account notes and call snippets:
- Company: mid-market B2B SaaS (customer success/product analytics). Currently 420 employees; heavy usage from support/product teams.
- Go-to-eval plan: start on Hosted API for quick integration, run 2-week POC on real support transcripts, measure latency/cost/quality, then move to Dedicated (reserved) for predictable unit economics if POC passes.
- Quoted targets (customer): p95 latency <200ms for chat inference (avg prompt + 256 tokens), sustained throughput ~120 concurrent chats (~5-10k tokens/min typical), peak bursts up to 4000 tokens/sec during daily digest runs. Cost sensitivity: finance wants modeled ARR impact; initial ask to keep inference spend < $0.5k/month for POC, target <$10k/month at scale for chat subsystem.
- Model preferences: open to small LLaMA-style finetuned variants and Redwood-curated quantized builds. Wants quantization profiles (4-bit prefer) + fallback to 8-bit for long-context generation. Important: routing policy to fallback to cheaper model for low-cost queries and higher-quality model for critical workflows (billing/agreements).
- Optimization workshop: agreed topics — batching (continuous batching for bursts), prefix/KV caching (customer has many repeated support templates), quantization tradeoffs (4-bit vs 8-bit), model selection routing (latency vs cost), instrumentation to measure tokens/latency/cost per-route. AE to provide Redwood Optimize playbook + model profiles.
- Security & compliance: SOC2 required, Okta SSO + SCIM, KMS for key management, EU data residency for EU customers, retention controls for support logs. Wants audit logs surfaced in Redwood Console.
- POC success metrics (draft):
  * functional: integrated chat assistant in support console with feature parity to prototype
  * perf: p95 latency <200ms, cold-warm response <350ms, error rate <0.5%
  * cost: effective token unit cost < target (to be modeled in workshop) and predictable cost curve for 100k env/month
  * quality: NPS of support agent assist > baseline, sampling + eval to prevent hallucinations
- Quotes from calls: "We need a clear path from hosted -> dedicated without ripping out infra"; "If batching/caching can cut token spend by 40% we can justify Dedicated".
- POC plan: 1) Hosted integration + telemetry wiring (days 1-3), 2) baseline run on existing prompts (days 4-7), 3) Redwood Optimize workshop (day 8) with SE + infra to set batching/caching/quant profiles, 4) run optimized workload (days 9-12), 5) results review + decision (day 13-14).
- Risks / blockers: procurement timeline (legal needs SLA addendum), internal security wants firewall/egress rules for Hosted; if unacceptable they will push straight to Dedicated — need Dedicated price commitment for pilot.
- Ask from Redwood: provide Hosted POC credits, pre-baked quant profiles for candidate models, sample batching configs, cost-model spreadsheet showing unit economics at 10k/50k/200k tokens/day. SE to deliver by 2026-03-15.
